newsitem.title: SPAIN: Tubacex outpaces after analyst presentation.
newsitem.headline: Tubacex outpaces after analyst presentation.

text.p: Steel tube-maker Tubacex was Spain's top stock market performer on Wednesday after it presented a bright outlook to analysts.
At 1130 GMT, Tubacex was up 51 pesetas, 10.94 percent, to 517 pesetas in heavy trade. The Ibex-35 blue chip index was up 1.14 percent to 6,874.90.
Tubacex told Reuters it expected 1998 net profit to rise to 4.06 billion pesetas on sales of 29.8 billion pesetas, up from net profit of 3.12 billion pesetas at the end of 1996.
According to analysts at the presentation, these figures were given as conservative estimates.
"There's obviously clear room for earnings improvement if the company itself is so sure as to give these kind of forecasts," said a dealer at an independent brokerage.
But some said the shares were fully valued at these prices.

"We've changed our recommendation from buy to hold, simply because the stock has risen so much. We think that at around 490 pesetas per share the price would take into account all of its potential," said Javier Bernat, an analyst at Inverban brokerage.
He added that the likely reason for such a strong rise was the stock's entry into the Ibex-35 blue chip index at the start of July.
"We think the run it's had has got more to do with reasons of liquidity in the run-up to entering the Ibex," Bernat said.
A trader at a foreign brokerage agreed.
"The stock's very hot at the moment, with a lot of interest, although how far it can go from here isn't too clear," he said.
